title: 13 al 28 de septiembre azotan al país los huracanes Huracán Ingrid y Manuel.
text: El huracán Ingrid fue el segundo huracán de la temporada de huracanes del 2013 y el más destructivo de la temporada, aunque no fue el más intenso. title: Clausura 2013 Copa MX (through April)
text: The Copa 2013 MX Clausura was the 69th staging of the Copa MX, the 42nd staging in the professional era and is the second tournament played since the 1996–97 edition. This tournament started on January 15, 2013, and concluded on April 10, 2013.

text: The Bank of Mexico, abbreviated BdeM or Banxico, is Mexico's central bank, monetary authority and lender of last resort. The Bank of Mexico is autonomous in exercising its functions, and its main objective is to achieve stability in the purchasing power of the national currency.

title: First same-sex marriage performed in Oaxaca
text: Same-sex marriage has been legal in Oaxaca since 26 August 2018, when the state civil registry announced it would process marriage applications from same-sex couples in line with jurisprudence established by the Supreme Court of Justice of the Nation. However, the couples required additional red tape compared to opposite-sex partners.

title: Club America wins the 2012–13 Liga MX season.
text: The 2012–13 Liga MX season was the 66th professional top-flight football league season in Mexico, and the first under the league's current identity as "Liga MX". The season was split into two competitions: the Torneo Apertura and the Torneo Clausura—each of identical format and contested by the same eighteen teams.

title: Chactún, a Mayan ruin, is discovered in Campeche
text: The Maya civilization was a Mesoamerican civilization that existed from antiquity to the early modern period. Known by its ancient temples and glyphs (script), the civilization is also noted for its art, architecture, mathematics, calendar, and astronomical system.

title: Chihuahua International Airport is closed because of flooding due to heavy rains.
text: Chihuahua International Airport; officially Aeropuerto Internacional General Roberto Fierro Villalobos (General Roberto Fierro Villalobos International Airport) (IATA: CUU, ICAO: MMCU) is an international airport located in Chihuahua, Mexico. It handles both national and international air traffic for the city of Chihuahua and is operated by Grupo Aeroportuario Centro Norte.

text: The 2013 World Taekwondo Championships was the 21st edition of the World Taekwondo Championships, and was held in Puebla, Mexico from 15 to 21 July 2013.

text: The Riviera Maya is a tourism and resort district located to the south of Cancún, Mexico. It straddles the coastal Federal Highway 307, along the Caribbean coastline of the state of Quintana Roo, located in the eastern portion of the Yucatán Peninsula.

title: 2013 Copa de México de Naciones in Aztec Stadium won by Argentina.
text: The 2013 Copa de México de Naciones is the 2nd edition of the Copa México de Naciones Sub-15 and it took place in Mexico from August 10 to August 18. The tournament is supposed to be the precursor the proposed U-15 FIFA World Cup.

title: Hurricane Manuel strikes much of Mexico
text: Hurricane Manuel was a catastrophic tropical cyclone that brought widespread flooding across much of Mexico in September 2013, in conjunction with Hurricane Ingrid. The fifteenth named storm and seventh hurricane of the annual hurricane season, Manuel originated from a strong area of low pressure south of Acapulco on September 13.

title: 2 – President Peña gives his first annual message.**Hurricane Ingrid strikes
text: Hurricane Ingrid was one of two tropical cyclones, along with Hurricane Manuel, to affect Mexico within a 24-hour period, the first such occurrence since 1958. Ingrid was the ninth named storm and second hurricane of the 2013 Atlantic hurricane season.

title: 5 – Chihuahua monster truck accident
text: The Chihuahua monster truck accident occurred on 5 October 2013 in Chihuahua City, Mexico, when a monster truck crashed into spectators at an air show. Eight people were reported killed, and 79 were injured.

title: Nuestra Belleza México 2013, won by Josselyn Garciglia from Baja California Sur.
text: Nuestra Belleza México 2013, the 20th annual Nuestra Belleza México beauty pageant, was held at the Presidential Hangar of Aeropuerto Internacional "Lic. Adolfo López Mateos" in Toluca, Estado de México, Mexico on October 19, 2013.

title: Hurricane Raymond strikes the southwestern coast
text: Hurricane Raymond was an erratic Category 3 major hurricane which briefly threatened the southwestern coast of Mexico before re-curving back out to sea. The seventeenth named storm, eighth hurricane, and only major hurricane of the 2013 Pacific hurricane season, Raymond developed from a tropical wave on October 20 south of Acapulco, Mexico.

title: S&P Global Ratings increases Mexico credit rating to BBB+.
text: S&P Global Ratings is an American credit rating agency (CRA) and a division of S&P Global that publishes credit ratings on debt issued by companies, governments and structured finance vehicles. S&P is considered the largest of the Big Three credit-rating agencies, which also include Moody's Ratings and Fitch Ratings.
